mode: Production HTML/JS/preload in isolated Electron with a synthetic SDK and synthetic callback proofs; every external request blocked or substituted
checks: SDK template evaluation is permitted only inside the isolated captcha page
root SDK download errors are visible and can be retried
missing SDK export and invalid challenge configuration fail visibly
SDK initialization exceptions do not leave the page permanently loading
blocked SDK resources identify the client policy failure without exposing URLs
asynchronous SDK failures display a recovery action
full initialization timeout covers the gap between instance creation and challenge readiness
SDK verification failure retains its official refresh flow and sends no proof
reload destroys the old instance and rejects old ready and verification callbacks
successful synthetic completion is emitted once and late errors cannot undo it
cancellation invalidates held SDK callbacks without completing verification
limitations: Synthetic SDK callbacks exercise only the renderer lifecycle and bridge.
Live official component loading is a separate --live probe and is never run automatically in CI.
